# 最無比經

**Volume:** T16
**Category:** 經集部類

**Dynasty:** 唐

## Contributors

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T691 in one fascicle is [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)'s rendering of the same Indian sūtra as *[Xīyǒu jiàoliàng gōngdé jīng 希有挍量功德經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0380)* (T690 by [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A)). The standard *Tang Catalogue of the Inner Tripiṭaka* (《大唐內典錄》) places this translation at Cí'ēnsì 慈恩寺 in **Zhēnguān 23 (649 CE)**, the year before [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)'s great translation programme shifted to Yùhuágōng 玉華宮. The opening colophon "大唐三藏法師玄奘奉詔譯" attributes the rendering to imperial decree.

**Abstract**

[玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)'s 649 version is the standardized late-Tang rendering of the merit-of-refuge-taking sūtra; the title 最無比 ("the most incomparable") translates the Sanskrit *anuttara* and signals that the text's principal claim is the unsurpassable supremacy of the three refuges as a generator of karmic merit. Like its Suí predecessor T690, the sūtra opens at Śrāvastī (室羅筏 in [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)'s transliteration) with Ānanda's question and proceeds through escalating *jiàoliàng* (comparative-calculation) similes. The terminological shift from older to standardized Tang Yogācāra-style transliteration ("室羅筏" for Śrāvastī, "苾芻" for *bhikṣu*, "薄伽梵" for *bhagavān*) is again evident.

The pairing of [KR6i0380](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0380) (T690) and [KR6i0381](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0381) (T691) is a classic case of Suí-period and Tang-period rendering of the same Indian original — useful for tracking the development of Chinese Buddhist technical vocabulary across the late sixth to mid seventh century.

Related canonical text: earlier translation [KR6i0380](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0380) (T690).
